info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Deposit Lending Merchandising Loan-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of merchandising loans within the deposit lending framework. It allows financial institutions to streamline the process of offering loans tailored for merchandising purposes, catering to businesses that require immediate funding. Typical consumers include banks and fintech companies looking to enhance their lending offerings. By leveraging this API, institutions can efficiently onboard new loan applications and manage their lending portfolio effectively.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a merchandising loan by providing the required details in the request body. Ensure that all necessary information is included to successfully process the loan application.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a merchandising loan. This should include all necessary parameters to process the loan request effectively.

201.description: The merchandising loan has been successfully created.
